evidence_excerpts: Paradigm cases of grounding have the relevant epistemic feature, two of which we’ve already discussed: the grounding of [p∧q] in [p], [q], and the grounding of [p⁄q] in [p], for some suitable p and q.
text: Paradigm cases such as the grounding of conjunctions and disjunctions support the significance principle because their connecting questions lack substantive content even with little background knowledge.
